stem.alt: Skeletal formula of a five-membered ring containing a ring oxygen and a ketone group, with methyl groups next to the ring oxygen and a formate ester (-OCHO) group on one ring carbon.

stem.text: What is the structure of the carboxylic acid that would be obtained by acid hydrolysis of the ester linkage?

A.alt: Displayed formula of formic acid: H-C(=O)-OH.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of an open chain with a HO-C(=O) group at the left end, an OH group, and an O-C(=O)CH3 group at the right end.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a ring compound with a ketone group and an O-C(=O)OH group on a ring carbon.

D.alt: Skeletal formula of an open chain with a HO-C(=O) group at the left end, a ketone group in the middle and an O-C(=O)CH3 group at the right end.
